e.title: TabPFN for Insurance Pricing
e.summary: TabPFN 保险定价论文代码（arXiv 2605.22892，MIT）：先验拟合 transformer 的表格数据定价
e.body: TabPFN for Insurance Pricing 是论文配套代码（Deprez, Verbeke, Verdonck 2026；arXiv 2605.22892，MIT）：把 TabPFN（prior-fitted transformer，先验拟合的表格数据模型）应用于保险定价——零训练/少样本的表格数据深度模型在费率厘定上的表现。对 RIAA：表格数据基础模型的保险定价研究实现（薄数据场景的价值）。与 [[insurance-thin-data]]（burning-cost 薄数据）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[tweedie]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：arXiv 2605.22892（TabPFN for Insurance Pricing），MIT
e.summary_en: Paper code for TabPFN in insurance pricing (arXiv 2605.22892, MIT): prior-fitted transformer for tabular-data pricing
e.summary_hk: TabPFN 保險定價論文代碼（arXiv 2605.22892，MIT）：先驗擬合 transformer 的表格數據定價
e.body_en: TabPFN for Insurance Pricing is the companion code of the paper (Deprez, Verbeke, Verdonck 2026; arXiv 2605.22892, MIT): applying TabPFN (prior-fitted transformer — a tabular-data foundation model) to insurance pricing — the performance of zero-training/few-shot tabular deep models in ratemaking. For RIAA: a research implementation of tabular foundation models in insurance pricing (their value in thin-data settings). Complements [[insurance-thin-data]] (burning-cost thin data), [[machine-learning-pricing]] and [[tweedie]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[claim-frequency]].
e.body_hk: TabPFN for Insurance Pricing 是論文配套代碼（Deprez, Verbeke, Verdonck 2026；arXiv 2605.22892，MIT）：把 TabPFN（prior-fitted transformer，先驗擬合的表格數據模型）應用於保險定價——零訓練/少樣本的表格數據深度模型在費率釐定上的表現。對 RIAA：表格數據基礎模型的保險定價研究實現（薄數據場景的價值）。與 [[insurance-thin-data]]（burning-cost 薄數據）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[tweedie]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
